draft_review_observations.observation: No readable body text after scripts/styles/noscript removal during operator inspection; no browser or resources executed.

editorial_network_requests_bounds.basis: Six single source fetch operations; PeerJ changed final URL within same origin; client allows at most two redirects and does not expose hop count in its summary.

plos-one.root_cause: Preparing the 513th eligible evidence unit exceeds the existing 512-unit document cap, PrepareDocument.php line 268; not the 4096-element cap. Four expected positives remain FN; ambiguous observations on this failed page are not claimed CA.

joss.root_cause: Explicit no-APC paragraph under Cost and Sustainability Model is rejected by the strict supported-heading context whitelist. Fee grammar also does not support this longer prose statement. Submission link is in header/nav excluded by preparation; its Submit label is outside current LinkRule grammar.

peerj.root_cause: Stored HTML is an application shell; zero readable body text after inert script/style/noscript exclusion. No expected positive facts, no invented CA/FN.

elife.root_cause: Aims and scope heading is unsupported and the article-types unit exceeds the eight-level ancestry bound. No global article-type assertion emitted. Domain-qualified statements remain OOS, not positive targets.
